gestalt.total_denominator: REJECT: the bounded prototype is useful research but has no complete operation ledger, 168-source launcher, shards, publication lifecycle, or independently adequate semantic oracle. Running the full corpus now would produce unauditable volume rather than denominator proof.
gestalt.wave: REJECT: the one-stream direction, exact zero-credit labels, parsed attributes, byte ranges, and isolated research root are sound; the implemented state, structure, owner, work, and oracle semantics contain confirmed counterexamples.

features.source_partition: REJECT: malformed raw closing tags and astral escapes cross state boundaries incorrectly.
features.reference_candidates: REJECT: empty hrefs violate the oracle; excluded raw references can receive semantic definition targets; candidate collision handling truncates and silently drops.
features.structure_and_ownership: REJECT: headings can begin mid-line, tag-split ATX and Setext forms are omitted, same-name nesting is paired with the first later close, and carrier provenance can be self-consistently fabricated.
features.operation_ledger: REJECT: explicit operations bind by sequence and duplicate heading rows can claim the same interval; required source and byte locators are not executable join keys.
features.oracle: REJECT: it validates internal consistency rather than independently deriving required discoveries; empty, fabricated, state-substituted, source-base-substituted, owner-substituted, and work-suppressed analyses can pass.
features.work_bound: REJECT: transition_count counts source movement while omitting repeated suffix parsing, whole-source lowercase/search, prefix byte-length conversion, relation joins, URL work, and other helpers; measured false raw-end families are superlinear.

accepted_narrow_evidence: The V9 fixtures expose the right V8 defect classes and the analyzer/oracle split is a better research topology than the rejected V8 shared generator-oracle path.

The exact bounded suite deterministically replayed 18 V9 fixtures, 29 inherited regression cases, 512 no-throw inputs, 13 declared states, seven malformed scale points, and 15 named mutations; those facts remain evidence about the exact rejected subject only.
This analyzer is corpus research tooling and creates no lexer, scanner, token, atom, CST, or parser authority in the direct parse-that grammar.
required_repair: Repair every reproduced state, heading, nesting, href, disposition, carrier, operation-ledger, collision, and UTF-8 counterexample and add it to the exact test corpus.
Make the oracle derive required semantics from source plus independently frozen expected inputs, including omissions and fabrications; do not accept self-consistency as semantic truth.
Eliminate hidden superlinear paths and count all bounded work, or replace the transition claim with an honest measured resource contract.
After a new exact repaired subject earns two fresh challenges and root acceptance, materialize and independently review the normative operation ledger before any 168-source execution.
A later full-source run still requires content-addressed cwd-independent launcher/import closure, resource limits, arbitrary-output publication, and real crash/fault evidence.
